scripts.text:
[Jet]
Every god never grows old
Because of beautiful
Goddess, Idun.
Keeper of the apples of youth
Goddess of immortality.
scripts.translation:
[杰特]
諸神之所以永不衰老，皆因美麗的伊頓女神。
她是青春之蘋果的守護者，也是永生女神。

scripts.text:
[Jet]
Ooh, you're an Archer?
There was a time when I too
was an Archer. But I've changed jobs, so now I entertain the masses with my songs and humor.
scripts.translation:
[杰特]
噢，你是弓箭手？
曾經我也是一名弓箭手。不過我轉職了，現在用歌聲和幽默逗樂大家。

scripts.text:
[Jet]
Ooh...!
You're...!

[Jet]
You look bored...
Is life really that
mundane and tiresome?
Then... I shall make
you laugh...
scripts.translation:
[杰特]
你看起來很無聊...
生活真的那麼枯燥乏味嗎？
那...我就讓你笑一笑吧...

scripts.text:
[Jet]
Ooh...!
Hello, hello!
Wouldn't it be
nice if we could
perform together
one of these days?
scripts.translation:
[杰特]
噢...！
你好，你好！
要是有一天我們能一起表演，那該多好啊？

scripts.text:
[Jet]
Speaking of which...
Let me tell you a joke!
Trust me, it's hilarious~
^333333*Ahem*^000000
scripts.translation:
[杰特]
說到這個...
讓我給你講個笑話！
相信我，很好笑的~
^333333*咳咳*^000000

scripts.text:
[Jet]
A termite walks
into a bar and says,
'Is the bar tender here?'
Hahahahaha!
Bwehehehehe!
scripts.translation:
[杰特]
一隻白蟻走進酒吧說：
“這吧檯的木頭嫩不嫩？”
哈哈哈哈！
嘿嘿嘿嘿！

scripts.text:
[Jet]
Hahaha~!
Goodness,
I'm funny!
Now, you try!
Come on, make
up a joke~!
scripts.translation:
[杰特]
哈哈~！
天哪，我真幽默！
現在，輪到你了！
來，編個笑話~！

scripts.text: A joke, eh?
scripts.translation: 笑話，是嗎？

scripts.text:
[Jet]
Oh...
My...
God...

[Jet]
That was the greatest
joke I've ever heard in my
life! You really have a natural
talent for showmanship! You
just have to become a Bard!
scripts.translation:
[杰特]
這是我這輩子聽過的最好笑的笑話！你天生就有表演天賦！你一定要成為詩人！

scripts.text: Scream!
scripts.translation: 尖叫！

scripts.text:
[Jet]
W-Wow...
I don't know why, but that was truly amazing. You must have
what it takes to become a Dancer...
scripts.translation:
[杰特]
哇...
我不知道為什麼，但這真的很棒。你肯定有成為舞娘的潛質...

scripts.text:
[Jet]
But before any of that, you've got to get rid of the Archer look, no?
scripts.translation:
[杰特]
不過在那之前，你得先擺脫弓箭手的形象，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Jet]
Actually I'm a member of
the ^3131FFArcher's Guild^000000 'Icarus' which is to the ^3131FFleft of the job change office^000000. You should be able to
learn a lot from there.
scripts.translation:
[杰特]
其實我是^3131FF弓箭手公會^000000“伊卡洛斯”的成員，就在^3131FF轉職辦公室的左邊^000000。你應該能在那裡學到很多東西。

scripts.text:
[Jet]
Now now, go learn
everything and change
jobs so that you can
come play with me!
scripts.translation:
[杰特]
好了好了，去學點東西，轉職吧，這樣你就能來陪我玩了！

scripts.text:
[Jet]
Let's see...
I've been working
on a new joke here,
but I could use some
feedback. You ready?
scripts.translation:
[杰特]
讓我看看...
我最近正在創作一個新笑話，但需要一些反饋。你準備好了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Jet]
What did the male
Merchant say to the
dancing Isis? Give up?
scripts.translation:
[杰特]
那個男性商人對正在跳舞的蛇女伊絲說了什麼？
猜不到？

scripts.text:
[Jet]
'Mammonite!'
Get it? 'Cuz he
throws money at her
and the word Mammonite
sounds-- wait. It's not funny
if I have to explain it, huh?
scripts.translation:
[杰特]
“金錢攻擊！”
懂嗎？因為他向她扔錢，而且金錢攻擊這個詞聽起來——等等。如果我要解釋就不好笑了，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Jet]
^333333*Ahem*^000000
These are the
famous last words
of a mafia hit man...
scripts.translation:
[杰特]
^333333*咳咳*^000000
這是黑幫殺手最後的遺言...

scripts.text:
[Jet]
'Who put the
violin in this
violin case?!'
Bwahahahahahahah!
Get the joke?
scripts.translation:
[杰特]
“誰把小提琴放進這個琴盒裡的？！”
哇哈哈哈哈哈！
懂這個笑話嗎？

scripts.text:
Archer Job Change Office ---> 
 <--- Icarus
scripts.translation:
弓箭手轉職處 ---> 
 <--- 伊卡洛斯

scripts.text:
[Master Kavaruk]
Hello, young one.
I am Master Kavaruk
of the Icarus Archer Guild.
I bid you welcome.
scripts.translation:
[卡瓦魯克大師]
你好，年輕人。
我是伊卡洛斯弓箭手公會的卡瓦魯克大師。
歡迎你。

scripts.text: Ask about 'Icarus.'
scripts.translation: 詢問關於“伊卡洛斯”的事

scripts.text: Ask about recent news.
scripts.translation: 詢問最近的新聞

scripts.text: Talk about Archers.
scripts.translation: 聊聊弓箭手

scripts.text:
[Master Kavaruk]
Have you ever
heard the story
of Icarus before?
scripts.translation:
[卡瓦魯克大師]
你以前聽說過伊卡洛斯的故事嗎？

scripts.text:
[Master Kavaruk]
Icarus was a brave young man who flew through the sky using wings held together by beeswax. Out of curiosity, he flew too close to the sun, his wings melted, and he fell to his death.
scripts.translation:
[卡瓦魯克大師]
伊卡洛斯是一個勇敢的年輕人，他使用蜂蠟粘合的翅膀在天空中飛翔。出於好奇，他飛得太靠近太陽，翅膀融化了，最終墜亡。

scripts.text:
[Master Kavaruk]
Although his is a tragic story, Icarus had a courageous heart
that we should look up to as
our standard.
scripts.translation:
[卡瓦魯克大師]
雖然這是一個悲劇，但伊卡洛斯擁有我們應當效仿的勇敢之心。

scripts.text:
[Master Kavaruk]
The members of our guild are those who not only wish to be brave, but to reach out for our dreams like Icarus did. Our members are aspiring Archers, former Archers and current Archers.
scripts.translation:
[卡瓦魯克大師]
我們公會的成員不僅渴望勇敢，更渴望像伊卡洛斯那樣去追逐夢想。我們的成員包括立志成為弓箭手的人、前弓箭手以及現任弓箭手。

scripts.text:
[Master Kavaruk]
In fact, a few of our
members specialize in
capturing the fascination
of those watching with their
graceful dances, just like you.
scripts.translation:
[卡瓦魯克大師]
事實上，我們公會中有幾位成員擅長用優雅的舞姿吸引觀眾的目光，就像你一樣。

scripts.text:
[Master Kavaruk]
In fact, a few of our members
are highly skilled in singing and entertaining their allies, much in the same way you do.
scripts.translation:
[卡瓦魯克大師]
事實上，我們公會中有幾位成員擅長歌唱和娛樂盟友，和你一樣。

scripts.text:
[Master Kavaruk]
If you'd like to become an Archer, why don't you go around and learn
a few things about the profession? I'm sure you'll be able to hear plenty of stories around here.
scripts.translation:
[卡瓦魯克大師]
如果你想成為弓箭手，不妨四處走走，瞭解一下這個職業。我相信你在這裡能聽到不少故事。

scripts.text:
[Master Kavaruk]
Since you're an Archer, you might
benefit from going around and listening to everyone else's battle experiences. Becoming familiar with different fight scenarios will help you in the future.
scripts.translation:
[卡瓦魯克大師]
既然你是弓箭手，不妨四處走走，聽聽其他人的戰鬥經驗。熟悉不同的戰鬥場景會對你的未來有所幫助。

scripts.text:
[Master Kavaruk]
[Master Kavaruk]
Arpesto is waiting
outside. Since he's a
veteran hunter, he can
be of great help to you.
scripts.translation:
[卡瓦魯克大師]
阿爾佩斯托正在外面等候。既然他是一位經驗豐富的獵人，他一定能對你很有幫助。

scripts.text:
[Master Kavaruk]
They happen to know a lot of information about jobs related to Archers. Why don't you speak to them and learn more about
these other jobs?
scripts.translation:
[卡瓦魯克大師]
他們恰好知道很多關於與弓箭手相關職業的資訊。不妨和他們對話，瞭解更多關於這些其他職業的事情？

scripts.text:
[Master Kavaruk]
...But I don't seem to see
any of them around here right now. They never seem to remain in one
place for very long. Still, I'm sure of them will turn up here
one of these days.
scripts.translation:
[卡瓦魯克大師]
...但我似乎沒看到他們在這裡。他們似乎從不長時間停留在一個地方。不過，我相信他們中會有人某天出現在這裡。

scripts.text:
[Master Kavaruk]
...But I don't seem to see any of them around here right now. They always wander wherever the wind takes them, but I'm sure one of them will wander back here one
of these days.
scripts.translation:
[卡瓦魯克大師]
...但我似乎沒看到他們在這裡。他們總是隨風飄蕩，但我相信他們中會有人某天回到這裡。

scripts.text:
[Master Kavaruk]
Oh, it's a good thing
you're here, {0}.
I've just received request for support from the Alchemist
Guild in Al De Baran.
scripts.translation:
[卡瓦魯克大師]
哦，你來得正好，{0}。
我剛收到艾爾帕蘭鍊金術士公會發出的支援請求。

scripts.text:
[Master Kavaruk]
Hmmm...
..........

[Master Kavaruk]
Find Arthail
of the Wind for me.
He must be somewhere
in Prontera...
scripts.translation:
[卡瓦魯克大師]
幫我找找風之阿爾塞爾。
他應該在普隆德拉的某個地方...

scripts.text:
[Master Kavaruk]
Hmmm, I see. Thank you
for bringing me the news. As Arthail has said, I shall wait until he has more news for me.
You should also train and prepare for the future as well.
scripts.translation:
[卡瓦魯克大師]
嗯，我明白了。謝謝你告訴我這個訊息。正如阿爾塞爾所說，我會等他帶來更多訊息。
你也應該好好訓練，為未來做好準備。

scripts.text:
[Master Kavaruk]
I don't know...
Recently, I haven't heard any noteworthy news. For now, the warmth of the sun seems to be protecting the peace here.
scripts.translation:
[卡瓦魯克大師]
我不知道...
最近，我沒有聽到什麼值得注意的訊息。目前看來，陽光的溫暖似乎正在守護著這裡的和平。

scripts.text:
[Master Kavaruk]
They've been taking care
of a Flora field as a way of supplying their funds, but recently some stray cats seem to have been destroying the plants there.
scripts.translation:
[卡瓦魯克大師]
他們一直在照料芙羅拉田，以此作為資金來源，但最近似乎有些流浪貓在破壞那裡的植物。

scripts.text:
[Master Kavaruk]
Although the Alchemists have been using Alchemy to summon the Flora again to keep the field running, it's causing a strain on their resources.
scripts.translation:
[卡瓦魯克大師]
雖然鍊金術士們一直在使用鍊金術重新召喚芙羅拉以維持田地運作，但這給他們的資源造成了很大的負擔。

scripts.text:
[Master Kavaruk]
They are willing to give rewards for bringing materials such as ^3131FFManeater Blossoms^000000 and ^3131FFStems^000000 which will help them restore
their Flora.
scripts.translation:
[卡瓦魯克大師]
他們願意為提供^3131FF噬人樹花^000000和^3131FF莖^000000等材料的人給予獎勵，這將有助於他們恢復芙羅拉。

scripts.text:
[Master Kavaruk]
If you're interested, it would probably be best to speak to the Alchemist Guild member who is waiting to hear from us at the ^3131FFshop next to the road south of Icarus^000000.
scripts.translation:
[卡瓦魯克大師]
如果你感興趣，最好去和那位正在等待我們訊息的鍊金術士公會成員對話，他在^3131FF伊卡洛斯南側道路旁的商店^000000。

scripts.text: Is something the matter?
scripts.translation: 出什麼事了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Master Kavaruk]
Actually, we have a problem.
The position of master seems to have a lot of power, but I always need to remain here. I don't have the luxury of being able to leave my post.
scripts.translation:
[卡瓦魯克大師]
其實，我們遇到了一個問題。
雖然大師這個職位擁有很大的權力，但我必須一直留在這裡。我沒有離開崗位的餘裕。

scripts.text:
[Master Kavaruk]
I asked a member of Icarus to
wander about the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom and gather news and information about what has been going on recently.
scripts.translation:
[卡瓦魯克大師]
我讓伊卡洛斯的一名成員在盧恩·米德加茲王國四處遊蕩，收集最近發生的訊息和資訊。

scripts.text:
[Master Kavaruk]
He has been sending me letters containing detailed information, but all of a sudden, I've lost contact with him. I'm concerned over what may have happened.
scripts.translation:
[卡瓦魯克大師]
他一直在給我寄信件，裡面包含詳細的資訊，但突然之間，我失去了與他的聯絡。我很擔心他可能發生了什麼。

scripts.text:
[Master Kavaruk]
Would you please go find
^3131FFArthail of the Wind^000000 for me? Although he doesn't like people, I've ordered for him to wander within the crowds to gather information.
scripts.translation:
[卡瓦魯克大師]
請你幫我找找^3131FF風之阿爾塞爾^000000好嗎？雖然他不喜歡與人接觸，但我命令他在人群中游蕩以收集資訊。

scripts.text:
[Master Kavaruk]
Please find out if he is all right and help him with whatever he
may need. In the meantime, I will be waiting to hear from you. Thank you very much.
scripts.translation:
[卡瓦魯克大師]
請確認他是否安好，並幫助他解決任何他可能需要的事情。在此期間，我會等待你的訊息。非常感謝。

scripts.text:
[Master Kavaruk]
But if I hear of
any interesting rumors,
I will let you know.
scripts.translation:
[卡瓦魯克大師]
但如果我聽到任何有趣的傳聞，我會告訴你的。

scripts.text:
[Master Kavaruk]
[Master Kavaruk]
Arpesto is waiting
outside. Since he's a
veteran hunter, he can
be of great help to you.
scripts.translation:
[卡瓦魯克大師]
阿爾佩斯托正在外面等候。既然他是一位經驗豐富的獵人，他一定能對你很有幫助。

scripts.text:
[Master Kavaruk]
Although you may not be able
to directly apply archery related knowledge, it's a good idea to understand the capabilities of
your Archer allies.
scripts.translation:
[卡瓦魯克大師]
雖然你可能無法直接應用與弓箭手相關的知識，但瞭解你的弓箭手盟友的能力是個好主意。

scripts.text:
[Master Kavaruk]
Ah...
So are you
interested in
becoming an Archer?
scripts.translation:
[卡瓦魯克大師]
啊...
那麼你是對成為弓箭手感興趣嗎？

scripts.text:
[Master Kavaruk]
Although I can't deny that you're an expert, I suppose it is a good idea to review the basics of archery from time to time. Would you like to try some refresher training?
scripts.translation:
[卡瓦魯克大師]
雖然我不能否認你是專家，但時不時複習一下弓箭手的基礎知識是個好主意。你想試試一些複習訓練嗎？

scripts.text:
[Master Kavaruk]
As an Archer, I can see that you'd want to make sure that you have a strong grasp on the fundamentals
of our job. Would you like some specialized instruction?
scripts.translation:
[卡瓦魯克大師]
作為一名弓箭手，我能看出你希望確保自己牢固掌握我們職業的基礎。你想接受一些專門指導嗎？

scripts.text:
[Master Kavaruk]
Hmm...?
What are you still
doing here? Go to the
hills west of Icarus and
talk to ^3131FFSeisner^000000 to begin your special training.
scripts.translation:
[卡瓦魯克大師]
嗯...？
你還在這裡做什麼？去伊卡洛斯西側的山丘，和^3131FF賽斯納^000000對話以開始你的特殊訓練。

scripts.text:
[Master Kavaruk]
So {0},
Did you have a good experience? Learning theory alone is never too enjoyable, but it is necessary.
scripts.translation:
[卡瓦魯克大師]
那麼{0}，你體驗得如何？僅學習理論從來都不是一件令人愉快的事，但它是必要的。

scripts.text:
[Master Kavaruk]
Reidin Corse is just outside of this building. Didn't you see him on your way in?
scripts.translation:
[卡瓦魯克大師]
雷丁·科斯就在這個建築外面。你進來的時候沒看到他嗎？

scripts.text:
[Master Kavaruk]
You're great
just as you are now.
Still, if you feel like you need something, speak to any of the guild members and listen to their life experiences.
scripts.translation:
[卡瓦魯克大師]
你現在的樣子就很棒了。
不過，如果你覺得還需要什麼，可以和公會的任何成員對話，聽聽他們的生活經歷。

scripts.text:
[Master Kavaruk]
How would you like
some specialized instruction to learn more about the Archer job?
scripts.translation:
[卡瓦魯克大師]
你想接受一些專門指導，以更深入地瞭解弓箭手這個職業嗎？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Master Kavaruk]
Ah yes. Well then, please
take this message over to ^3131FFSeisner^000000 who is in the Training Grounds west of Icarus.
scripts.translation:
[卡瓦魯克大師]
啊，是的。那麼，請把這封信帶給^3131FF賽斯納^000000，她在伊卡洛斯西側的訓練場。

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou've received
Kavaruk's message
for Seisner.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你收到了卡瓦魯克給賽斯納的信。^000000

scripts.text:
[Master Kavaruk]
Seisner is very diligent,
composed, intelligent and
extremely capable. I believe
that you can learn much from her.
scripts.translation:
[卡瓦魯克大師]
賽斯納非常勤奮、沉穩、聰明且能力出眾。我相信你能從她身上學到很多東西。

scripts.text:
[Master Kavaruk]
Ah, I see. Well,
Icarus will always welcome
you with open arms. If you
ever change your mind, feel
free to come back.
scripts.translation:
[卡瓦魯克大師]
啊，我明白了。伊卡洛斯的大門永遠向你敞開。如果你改變主意，隨時歡迎回來。

scripts.text:
[Master Kavaruk]
Now it is time to experience the principles you've just learned firsthand. Go speak to ^3131FFReidin Corse^000000, who is just outside of this building, and he'll tell you about the different skills.
scripts.translation:
[卡瓦魯克大師]
現在，是時候親身體驗你剛學到的原則了。去和^3131FF雷丁·科斯^000000對話，他就在這個建築外面，他會向你介紹不同的技能。

scripts.text:
[Master Kavaruk]
Still, there's no need for you to do any field training since only Archers can actually participate
in that.
scripts.translation:
[卡瓦魯克大師]
不過，你不需要進行實地訓練，因為只有弓箭手才能參加那種訓練。

scripts.text:
You're great
just as you are now.
Still, if you feel like you need something, speak to any of the guild members and listen to their life experiences.
scripts.translation:
你現在的樣子就很棒了。
不過，如果你覺得還需要什麼，可以和公會的任何成員對話，聽聽他們的生活經歷。

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
[Reidin Corse]
Why are you carrying
so much stuff? You better put everything you don't need into Kafra Storage.
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
[雷丁·科斯]
你為什麼帶這麼多東西？最好把不需要的東西都放進卡普拉倉庫。

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Hey, you're carrying an
awful lot of stuff. You ought
to put some of your things
into Kafra Storage...
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
嘿，你帶了好多東西啊。你應該把一些東西放進卡普拉倉庫...

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Ah, what is it?
Can I help you
with something?
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
啊，怎麼了？
有什麼我可以幫你的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
You ready? I think it's fair to remind you that I won't tolerate any complaining! Just do what
I say and you'll be the second best Archer in the world! After me, of course~
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
準備好了嗎？我想提醒你，我不容忍任何抱怨！只要照我說的做，你就會成為世界上第二厲害的弓箭手！當然，第一是我~

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Ah, you're
finally back.
You've kept me
waiting for a while!
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
啊，你終於回來了。
你讓我等了好一會兒！

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Hey! I told
you to learn
Level 3 Owl's Eye!
Try not to learn something
else by accident, okay?
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
嘿！我讓你學3級鶚梟之眼！
別不小心學了別的技能，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Alright, open
your Skill Window.
Since you have Level 3
Owl's Eye, now you oughta be
able to see the Vulture's Eye
skill in the list too.
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
好的，開啟你的技能視窗。
既然你有3級鶚梟之眼，現在你應該能在列表裡看到蒼鷹之眼技能了。

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Mandagora lives in the area north of Geffen. Learn up to Level 3 Vulture's Eye and get acquainted with your attack range.
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
曼達戈拉生活在吉芬北部的區域。學會3級蒼鷹之眼，並熟悉你的攻擊範圍。

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Mandagora lives in the area north and east of Prontera. Learn up to Level 3 Vulture's Eye and get acquainted with your attack range.
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
曼達戈拉生活在普隆德拉北部和東部的區域。學會3級蒼鷹之眼，並熟悉你的攻擊範圍。

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Ah, so you've learned
a little something about Vulture's Eye! What do you think about it now? Ah, and here's a little reward for you before I start the next lesson~
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
啊，看來你學到了一些關於蒼鷹之眼的知識！你現在覺得它怎麼樣？啊，在我開始下一課之前，先給你一點小獎勵~

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Okay...
Up till now we've
studied Passive Skills.
You know, Owl's Eye
and Vulture's Eye.
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
好的...
到目前為止，我們學習了被動技能。
也就是鶚梟之眼和蒼鷹之眼。

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Now, I've taught you a lot of stuff and I wanna make sure you retain all of it. That's why I want you to take this midterm. Your mission: ^FF0000Attack the Rockers^000000!
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
現在，我教了你很多東西，我想確保你全都記住了。所以我要你參加這次期中考試。你的任務：^FF0000攻擊蝗蟲^000000！

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Hey...
You gotta bring
^3131FF10 Grasshopper's Leg^000000 to pass my midterm! Go back to the southwest area of Prontera and get them!
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
嘿...
要通過我的期中考試，你必須帶^3131FF10個蝗蟲後腿^000000來！回到普隆德拉的西南區域去收集吧！

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Hey...
You gotta bring
^3131FF10 Tentacles^000000 and
^3131FF1 Crystal Blue^000000 to pass my midterm! Go back to the dungeon on Byalan Island and get them!
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
嘿...
要通過我的期中考試，你必須帶^3131FF10個觸手^000000和^3131FF1個水靈礦石^000000來！回到拜蘭島的地下城去收集吧！

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Why are you carrying
so much stuff? You better put everything you don't need into Kafra Storage.
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
你身上怎麼帶了這麼多東西？最好把不需要的東西都放進卡普拉倉庫。

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Hey, you're back!
Let's see now...
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
嘿，你回來了！
讓我看看...

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Alright, now there's only
one more skill you need to know about. Personally, I think this one is crucial for every Archer...
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
好了，現在只剩下一個技能需要了解了。就我個人而言，我認為這對每個弓箭手來說都至關重要...

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
^333333*Sigh*^000000
It was a pain in the
ass, but we're finally
done with all of your lessons.
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
^333333*嘆氣*^000000
真是讓人頭疼，但我們終於完成了所有的課程。

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Remember, you
need to head into
the forest east of Payon and get me
^3131FF10 Mushroom Spores^000000
and ^3131FF10 Pointed Scales^000000.
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
記住，你需要前往斐揚東邊的森林，給我帶^3131FF10個香菇芽孢^000000和^3131FF10個鱗片梗^000000回來。

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Remember, you
need to head over to
Mt. Mjolnir and get me
^3131FF5 Maneater Blossoms^000000
and ^3131FF20 Stems^000000.
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
記住，你需要前往雷神之錘山，給我帶^3131FF5個噬人樹花^000000和^3131FF20個莖^000000回來。

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Ha-ha~!
You look more like
a veteran than a rookie
now! Yeap, I can see it
in your eyes.
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
哈哈~！
你現在看起來更像老手而不是新人了！沒錯，我從你的眼神里看出來了。

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
I really like this town.
There's so much lush greenery
and the birds are always singing. Payon really is peaceful.
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
我真的很喜歡這個城鎮。
這裡綠意盎然，鳥兒總是歌唱。斐揚真的很寧靜。

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
I really like this town.
Everything is green and birds singing all around.. such a peaceful place Payon is.
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
我真的很喜歡這個城鎮。
到處都是綠色，鳥兒在周圍歌唱...斐揚真是個寧靜的地方。

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Allow me to introduce myself. I'm the Archer of all Archers, ^3131FFReidin Corse^000000, Master of the Icarus Guild!
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
請允許我自我介紹。我是所有弓箭手中的弓箭手，^3131FF雷丁·科斯^000000，伊卡洛斯公會的會長！

scripts.text: Tell me about skills.
scripts.translation: 告訴我關於技能的事

scripts.text: Er, not really...
scripts.translation: 呃，不太清楚...

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Huh. So Master
Kavaruk told you
to come to me, eh?
Alright. Okay.
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
哦。所以是卡瓦魯克大師讓你來找我，是嗎？
好吧。好的。

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Huh...?
Alright. You sure
you've got nothing
to ask me? You had
that look, you know?
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
嗯...？
好吧。你確定沒有什麼要問我的嗎？你剛才那個表情，你知道嗎？

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Fine. I'm an incredibly
busy guy, but I'll make time for you. I'll teach you what I know about Archer skills... On one condition!
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
好吧。我雖然是個非常忙碌的人，但我會為你騰出時間。我會教你我所知道的弓箭手技能... 只有一個條件！

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
From here on out, you gotta
call me ^3131FFChief^000000, got it? Stick with me and you'll become the second best archer in the world! How
about it, kid?
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
從現在開始，你必須叫我^3131FF首領^000000，明白嗎？跟著我，你會成為世界上第二厲害的弓箭手！怎麼樣，小傢伙？

scripts.text: You got it, Chief!
scripts.translation: 遵命，首領！

scripts.text: Ugh, no thanks~!
scripts.translation: 呃，不用了~！

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Ho ho!
That's the way to go!
Good good~ Call me Chief
from now on, you hear?
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
哈哈！
這就對了！
很好很好~ 從現在開始，叫我首領，聽到了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Huh? What kind of attitude
is that? Ah, I get it. You're not mature enough to recognize greatness when it's right
before you.
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
哼？這是什麼態度？
啊，我明白了。你還不夠成熟，無法認出站在你面前的偉大人物。

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Don't worry...
When you come crawlin'
back, I'll reconsider
teaching you.
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
別擔心...
等你爬回來求我的時候，我會重新考慮教你。

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Let's see...
How much do you know?
Mmmmmmmmmm...
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
讓我看看...
你瞭解多少？
嗯嗯嗯嗯嗯...

scripts.text: ^3355FFReidin Corse narrows his experienced eyes and sizes you up.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF雷丁·科斯眯起他那雙經驗豐富的眼睛，打量著你。^000000

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Alright! We got a fresh Archer here! You're lucky you came to me, I'm the best teacher you can find! But let me warn you, I teach at a really fast pace, so try to keep
up. Okay? Good.
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
很好！這裡有個新晉弓箭手！
你能來找我真是走運，我是你能找到的最好的老師！
但我得警告你，我教學進度很快，所以試著跟上。好嗎？很好。

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Okay. It looks like you know
some stuff. But even if you're
a little experienced, there's still room for you to learn. So try and keep up, got it?
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
好吧。看來你知道一些東西。
但即使你有一點經驗，你仍然有學習空間。所以試著跟上，明白嗎？

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Hey! You're ready to change jobs, aren't you? Don't waste time here and just get a new job already! Eh, or you can ask Master Kavaruk for something to do.
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
嘿！你準備好轉職了，不是嗎？
別在這裡浪費時間，直接去轉職吧！
呃，或者你可以找卡瓦魯克大師給你點任務做。

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Okay, I'm ready to begin the lessons! Come back over here once you've got your bow and arrows and everything else ready, got it?
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
好吧，我準備好開始上課了！
等你準備好弓箭和其他裝備後，再回來找我，明白嗎？

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Well, I'm ready to teach whenever you're ready to learn. Come back once your bow and arrows and everything else is ready, alright?
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
嗯，我隨時準備教學，只要你準備好學習。
等你準備好弓箭和其他裝備後，再回來，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
If you don't like it, you can just quit! No reason to stick around
if you can't keep up with the Chief, anyway.
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
如果你不喜歡，你可以直接退出！
反正如果你跟不上首領，也沒必要留下來。

scripts.text: Please teach me... Chief!
scripts.translation: 請教我...首領！

scripts.text: I want to quit.
scripts.translation: 我想退出

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
That's what I'm talkin' about! Yeah! Just trust me and you'll learn almost everything about Archer skills! Let's get started!
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
這才對嘛！
沒錯！只要信任我，你幾乎能學會所有弓箭手技能！
讓我們開始吧！

scripts.text: Yes, Chief!
scripts.translation: 是的，首領！

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Great...!
I like your style!
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
很好...！
我喜歡你的風格！

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Now, open your Skill Window (Alt+S). You oughta be able to see two skills: ^FF0000Owl's Eye^000000 and ^FF0000Double Strafe^000000. First, I'll talk about Owl's Eye.
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
現在，開啟你的技能視窗 (Alt+S)。
你應該能看到兩個技能：^FF0000鶚梟之眼^000000 和 ^FF0000二連矢^000000。
首先，我來談談鶚梟之眼。

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
We Archers need to be able to preceive the movements of our targets from far away. Now, even during the night, nothing can escape the eyes of an owl.
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
我們弓箭手需要能夠從遠處察覺目標的動向。
現在，即使在夜晚，也沒有東西能逃脫貓頭鷹的眼睛。

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
So we gotta train our vision so that we see the way owls do. Now
if you can't aim at your targets, you'd be horrible at archery, right? You gotta have Accuracy!
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
所以我們要訓練視力，像貓頭鷹那樣觀察。
如果你無法瞄準目標，那你的箭術肯定很差勁，對吧？
你需要擁有精準度！

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Now, your first assignment
is to learn ^3131FFLevel 3 Owl's Eye^000000!
From Morocc, if you travel south, you can fight Condors for your training.
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
現在，你的第一個任務是學會^3131FF3級鶚梟之眼^000000！
從夢羅克出發，向南走，你可以打禿鷹來訓練。

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Now, your first assignment
is to learn ^3131FFLevel 3 Owl's Eye^000000!
From Prontera, if you travel south, south and then west, you can fight Condors for your training.
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
現在，你的第一個任務是學會^3131FF3級鶚梟之眼^000000！
從普隆德拉出發，向南，再向南，然後向西，你可以打禿鷹來訓練。

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Huh. So you already know a little about Owl's Eye already, huh? Well then, I guess I oughta talk about something you don't know about!
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
哦。看來你已經對鶚梟之眼有點了解了，是嗎？
那好吧，我想我應該講講你不知道的東西！

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
You can head somewhere
else if you want, but if you don't know any training areas, then
just follow my great advice.
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
如果你願意，可以去別的地方，但如果你不知道哪裡有訓練場，那就聽聽我這位大師的建議吧。

scripts.text: I'll follow your advice, Chief!
scripts.translation: 我會聽從你的建議，首領！

scripts.text: I'll hunt somewhere else...
scripts.translation: 我去別的地方打怪...

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
I'll send you to
Morocc for now,
so don't forget the
directions I gave you.
Travel ^3131FFsouth^000000.
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
我現在先送你去夢羅克，所以別忘了我告訴你的方向。
向^3131FF南^000000走。

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
I'll send you to
Prontera for now,
so don't forget the
directions I gave you.
Travel ^3131FFsouth^000000, ^3131FFsouth^000000,
and then ^3131FFwest^000000.
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
我現在先送你去普隆德拉，所以別忘了我告訴你的方向。
向^3131FF南^000000，再向^3131FF南^000000，然後向^3131FF西^000000。

scripts.text: Leave right away~
scripts.translation: 馬上出發~

scripts.text: W-wait, let me get ready!
scripts.translation: 等...等等，讓我準備一下！

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
When you struggle
through the hardships
of training, just think
about trying to become as
good as the greatest Archer
ever: me.
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
當你努力克服訓練的艱辛時，想想試著成為有史以來最偉大的弓箭手：
也就是我。

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Okay...!
Off you go!
To Morocc!
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
好...！
出發吧！
去夢羅克！

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Okay...!
Off you go!
To Prontera!
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
好...！
出發吧！
去普隆德拉！

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Hm...?
What do you possibly
need to prepare? Alright,
do whatever it is you
need to do...
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
嗯...？
你到底需要準備什麼？
好吧，去做你需要做的事吧...

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Say what...?
Alright, then.
But the next time
you come here, you better
know Level 3 Owl's Eye!
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
說什麼...？
好吧，那就這樣。
但下次你來的時候，一定要學會3級鶚梟之眼！

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Huh. Okay.
And here I was
getting ready to
teach you all my
archery secrets!
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
哦。好吧。
我還以為正準備教你所有的箭術秘訣呢！

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Ah, but your eyes look a lot sharper than they used to be.
Here, this is a small, special reward for you.
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
啊，但你的眼神看起來比以前銳利多了。
來，這是給你的一點特別的獎勵。

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Not bad, but you really should master Owl's Eye. That means
you need to learn it all the way
up to Level 10!
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
不錯，但你真的應該精通鶚梟之眼。
也就是說你需要把它練到10級！

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Now, I guess I'll
talk about a different
skill in my next lecture, kay?
Come back when you're ready
to learn something new~
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
現在，我想在下一次講座中講講另一個技能，好嗎？
準備好學新東西時再回來吧~

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Now when you think
about vultures, what
exactly comes to mind?
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
說到禿鷲，你腦海中浮現的具體是什麼？

scripts.text: Sharp, precise eyes.
scripts.translation: 銳利、精準的目光

scripts.text: You, Chief.
scripts.translation: 您，首領

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Exactly!
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
沒錯！

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Hahahaha!
Well, I am famous
for my incredible
vision and precision!
^333333*Ahem*^000000 Anyway...
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
哈哈哈哈哈！
沒錯，我正是以超凡的視力和精準度聞名於世的！
^333333*咳咳*^000000 總之...

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Vultures circle the sky, find a target on the ground, and then very swiftly swoop down and ensnare their prey in their claws.
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
禿鷲在天空盤旋，鎖定地面上的目標，然後迅速俯衝，用利爪抓住獵物。

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
No doubt about it.
Vultures are awesome!
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
毫無疑問。
禿鷲太棒了！

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
The ^3131FFVulture's Eye^000000 skill allows
you to train your vision to be like a vulture's. You'll increase your Attack Accuracy and can target enemies from further away.
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
^3131FF蒼鷹之眼^000000技能能讓你訓練出像禿鷲一樣的視力。
這將提升你的攻擊命中率，並且可以鎖定更遠處的敵人。

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
I know that you can attack
from a distance now, but don't
be satisfied with just your current attack range. Learn Vulture's Eye so you can attack from even further distances.
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
我知道你現在已經可以遠端攻擊了，但不要滿足於當前的攻擊距離。
學會蒼鷹之眼，這樣你就能攻擊更遠的地方。

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Now for your
second assignment!
Go hunt Mandagora!
Mandagora don't move,
so they're perfect for target
practice from a distance!
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
接下來是你的第二個任務！
去獵殺曼達戈拉！
曼達戈拉不會移動，所以非常適合作為遠端射擊的練習目標！

scripts.text:
Alright, Mandagora usually live around Geffen. I can send you to Geffen, so just travel north from there to find
some of them.
scripts.translation: 好的，曼達戈拉通常生活在吉芬附近。我可以把你送到吉芬，然後你只需向北走就能找到它們。

scripts.text:
Alright, Mandagora usually live around Mt. Mjolnir. I can send you to Prontera, so just travel north, then east from there to find
some of them.
scripts.translation: 好的，曼達戈拉通常生活在雷神之錘山附近。我可以把你送到普隆德拉，然後你只需向北再向東走就能找到它們。

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Remember, the most
important thing is to level the Vulture's Eye skill and test the distance of your attack range.
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
記住，最重要的是提升蒼鷹之眼技能的等級，並測試你的攻擊距離。

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Remember, the most
important thing is to level the Vulture's Eye skill and test the distance of your attack range.
You've got plenty of arrows
for that, so go for it!
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
記住，最重要的是提升蒼鷹之眼技能的等級，並測試你的攻擊距離。
你有很多箭可以用來練習，所以加油吧！

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Here's a little something to encourage you. Since Mandagora are Earth property monsters, these Fire Arrows will work really well.
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
給你一點小鼓勵。
既然曼達戈拉是土屬性魔物，這些火箭矢會非常有效。

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Alright~
Ready to go?
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
好了~
準備好了嗎？

scripts.text: Let's go!
scripts.translation: 出發吧！

scripts.text: W-wait a minute!
scripts.translation: 等...等一下！

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Alright...!
Get a move on!
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
好吧...！
快點行動！

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
You still need
to get ready?
Hurry it up!
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
你還需要做準備嗎？
快點！

scripts.text:
Eh?
Wait a minute...
scripts.translation:
咦？
等一下...

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
You already
learned Vulture's Eye!
Why did I spend so much time explaining about it? Well, I guess we're ready to move on to the next lesson...
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
你已經學會了蒼鷹之眼！
我為什麼要花那麼多時間解釋它呢？好吧，我想我們準備好進入下一課了...

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Okay...
Are you
ready to go?
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
好了...
你準備好出發了嗎？

scripts.text: Go.
scripts.translation: 出發

scripts.text: Wait a moment.
scripts.translation: 等一下

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Alright...!
Get a move on!
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
好吧...！
快點行動！

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
You still need
to get ready?
Hurry it up!
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
你還需要做準備嗎？
快點！

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Even though you may not be doing anything, Passive Skills are always in effect. Now, it's time for me to teach you about an Active Skill
for Archers. Ready?
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
即使你什麼都沒做，被動技能也始終生效。現在，是時候教你弓箭手的主動技能了。準備好了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Today I'll tell
you all about
^3131FFDouble Strafe^000000!
Whaddya think?
Exciting, yes?
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
今天我要向你介紹^3131FF二連矢^000000！
你覺得怎麼樣？
很刺激，對吧？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I...
I already know
about Double Strafe.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我...
我已經知道二連矢了。

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
...
......

[Reidin Corse]
^333333*Sigh*^000000
Next lesson...

[Reidin Corse]
Just like its name, Double Strafe allows you to attack enemies with your arrows twice in a row! Booyah~
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
顧名思義，二連矢允許你連續用箭攻擊敵人兩次！萬歲~

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
As Double Strafe's level rises, its attack strength also increases. If you master this skill, you can do a great amount of damage to your enemies!
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
隨著二連矢等級的提升，其攻擊力也會增加。如果你掌握了這個技能，就能對敵人造成大量傷害！

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Hold your bow and arrow
like this, concentrate, aim,
then fire twice with all your
might! Practice Double Strafe
enough and you'll get used to it!
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
像這樣握住弓和箭，集中精神，瞄準，然後盡全力射出兩箭！
多練習二連矢，你就會習慣的！

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Now, there's another skill known as ^FF0000Arrow Shower^000000. Where Double Strafe uses 2 Arrows, Arrow Shower fires a bunch of arrows at once.
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
現在，還有一個技能叫做^FF0000箭雨^000000。二連矢使用2支箭，而箭雨則是一次射出大量箭矢。

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Not even I can handle
Arrow Shower all that well since it's really hard. Still, maybe if you trained more at it, you'd manage to pull it off?
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
連我自己都很難完全掌握箭雨，因為它真的很難。不過，如果你多練習，也許就能成功施展？

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Rockers live just southwest of Prontera.
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
蝗蟲生活在普隆德拉的西南方。

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Be aware that Rockers are earth element monsters!! ^3131FFSo they should be weak against fire^000000.
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
注意，蝗蟲是土屬性魔物！！^3131FF所以它們應該怕火^000000。

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Now go and bring ^3131FF10 Grasshopper's Leg^000000 from hunting Rockers.
Bring all of that and you pass~
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
現在去狩獵蝗蟲，帶^3131FF10個蝗蟲後腿^000000回來。
帶齊這些你就通過了~

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
It's easier to find them if you pass by the southern gate of Prontera and then head west. Alright, off you go, {0}~
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
經過普隆德拉的南門然後向西走，更容易找到它們。好了，去吧，{0}~

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
There's a ship that
leads to Byalan Island in Izlude, Prontera's satellite city. Ride that ship to Byalan Island.
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
普隆德拉的衛星城依斯魯得島有一艘開往拜蘭島的船。乘那艘船去拜蘭島吧。

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
In the center of that island is the entrance to a dungeon where a lot of Hydras live. Remember that it's a water dungeon, and that ^3131FFWater resists Fire^000000, ^3131FFbut is weak against Wind^000000.
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
在該島的中心有一個地下城入口，那裡有很多海葵。記住那是一個水屬性地下城，^3131FF水屬性抵抗火屬性^000000，^3131FF但怕風屬性^000000。

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Now go and bring ^3131FF10 Tentacles^000000
from hunting Hydra and ^3131FF1 Crystal Blue^000000, which you can get from hunting the Mushrooms there.
Bring all of that and you pass~
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
現在去狩獵海葵，帶^3131FF10個觸手^000000回來，還有從那裡的蘑菇身上獲得的^3131FF1個水靈礦石^000000。
帶齊這些你就通過了~

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
It's easier to find Izlude if you pass by Prontera, so head towards the fields near Prontera. Alright, off you go, {0}~
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
經過普隆德拉再前往依斯魯得島會更容易找到，所以朝著普隆德拉附近的田野方向走吧。好了，去吧，{0}~

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Good! You pass.
Don't forget that you gotta keep training and improve your skills. Before you know it, you'll be an expert almost as good as me!
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
很好！你通過了。
別忘了要持續訓練，提升你的技能。不知不覺間，你也會成為像我一樣厲害的專家！

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Open your Skill Window.
Make sure that you learn
^FF0000Increase Concentration^000000.
Now, how can I describe
how to do it?
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
開啟你的技能視窗。
確保你學會了^FF0000凝神^000000。
那麼，我該怎麼描述這個技能的使用方法呢？

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
I guess that first, you gotta quiet your mind and enter a state of complete concentration. Steadily draw your bowstring back. If there's even a millisecond of imbalance, you'll miss.
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
我想首先，你必須靜下心來，進入完全專注的狀態。穩穩地拉開弓弦。哪怕有一毫秒的失衡，你就會射偏。

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
We use Increase Concentration
to keep ourselves calm and focused to ^3131FFmaximize certain abilities and stats^000000. This skill enhances our performance as Archers immensely!
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
我們使用凝神來保持冷靜和專注，從而^3131FF最大化特定的能力和屬性^000000。這個技能極大地提升了我們弓箭手的表現！

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
You might not be able
to see it now, but as you become more skilled, you'll eventually recognize all the benefits of this skill.
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
你現在可能還看不出什麼，但隨著你變得更強，你最終會認識到這個技能的所有好處。

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Ah, but it's not time for
you to relax yet! Since I've given you a midterm, it's only fitting that I also give you a final!
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
啊，但你還不能放鬆！既然我給了你期中考試，那我也得給你期末考！

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Surprised, huh?
Well, this test is a little harder, but I'll help you out so there's
no need for you to fret.
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
很驚訝吧？
嗯，這次考試稍微難一點，但我會幫你的，所以不用太擔心。

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Now, go into the forest east of Payon and hunt Spores and Wormtails. Your test will be to bring back ^3131FF10 Mushroom Spores^000000 and
^3131FF10 Pointed Scales^000000.
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
現在，去斐揚東邊的森林，狩獵魔菇和森靈。你的考試任務是帶回^3131FF10個香菇芽孢^000000和^3131FF10個鱗片梗^000000。

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Now, go to Mt. Mjolnir and hunt Floras. Your test will be to bring back ^3131FF5 Maneater Blossoms^000000 and
^3131FF20 Stems^000000.
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
現在，去雷神之錘山，狩獵芙羅拉。你的考試任務是帶回^3131FF5個噬人樹花^000000和^3131FF20個莖^000000。

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
I know it's a little dangerous,
but I've got a pal who'll be there to help you. Of course, she's still in training, but...
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
我知道這有點危險，但我有個朋友會在那裡幫你。當然，她還在訓練中，但是...

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Oh...
And one last thing.
Take some of these.
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
哦...
還有一件事。
拿一些這個。

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
H-hey!
Why are you carrying
so much stuff? You better put everything you don't need into Kafra Storage.
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
嘿！
你為什麼帶這麼多東西？最好把你不需要的東西都放進卡普拉倉庫。

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
This stuff is just a little something to encourage you, so don't take it the wrong way! Now hurry up, get what I asked for,
and come back!
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
這些只是給你的一點鼓勵，別誤會了！現在快點，去拿我讓你拿的東西，然後回來！

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
From Prontera, you'd get to Mt. Mjolnir by traveling ^3131FFnorth^000000, ^3131FFnorth^000000 and then ^3131FFeast^000000. But if you want,
I can just send you there.
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
從普隆德拉出發，向^3131FF北^000000走，再向^3131FF北^000000，然後向^3131FF東^000000就能到雷神之錘山。但如果你願意，我可以直接把你送過去。

scripts.text: Go!
scripts.translation: 去吧！

scripts.text: W-Wait!
scripts.translation: 等等！

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Alright!
Oh, and if you get
the chance, give a hello to my Acolyte pal over there for me~
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
好的！
哦，如果你有機會，幫我向那邊的服事朋友問聲好~

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Huh?
Um, sure. But
there's no reason to
get so nervous, even if
this my final exam for you.
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
嗯？
嗯，當然。但即使這是我給你的期末考，也沒必要這麼緊張。

scripts.text:
Ha-ha~!
You look more like
a veteran than a rookie
now! Yeap, I can see it
in your eyes.
scripts.translation:
哈哈~！
你現在看起來更像老手，而不是新人了！
沒錯，我從你的眼神里看出來了。

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Right, did you get a chance to meet my Acolyte pal, Mafra? She's pretty shy, but I hope you two got along.
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
對了，你有機會見到我的服事朋友，瑪芙拉嗎？她有點害羞，但我希望你們倆相處得不錯。

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
I'm happy to tell
you that you've passed
my final exam! Here, take
this little reward!
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
很高興地告訴你，你通過了我的期末考！
拿著，這是給你的小獎勵！

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Well, it's like you're a full fledged Archer now. Honestly,
I've got nothing more to teach you. Well, about archery, anyway.
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
嗯，你現在算是個合格的弓箭手了。
說實話，關於射箭，我已經沒什麼可教你的了。

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Well, if you talk to him, Master Kavaruk might have something for you to do. He happens to have me running around to doing errands
for him too. That creep!
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
嗯，如果你去和他談談，卡瓦魯克大師可能會給你安排點任務。
他老是讓我跑腿給他辦事。那個傢伙！

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Well, {0},
It'd make me really happy if you get to the point where you develop a true love for the art of archery. I'll see you sometime, okay?
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
嗯，{0}，如果你能真正愛上射箭這門藝術，我會非常開心的。
我們後會有期，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Of course, I've got friends here that I can trust with my life. We always argue, but we all want what's best for each other.
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
當然，我這裡有可以託付性命的摯友。
我們總是吵架，但我們彼此都希望對方過得好。

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Wouldn't you
agree that it's
wonderful to have
great friends?
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
你覺得，擁有這樣的好朋友是不是很美好？

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
I feel so happy laying in the grass and looking up at the sky.
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
躺在草地上仰望天空，我感到無比幸福。

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
It might also be because I have my trustable friends here with me. Haha.
We always argue, but we care for each other deep down inside.
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
也許是因為我有這些值得信賴的朋友在身邊。哈哈。
我們總是吵架，但內心深處我們都很在乎彼此。

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
..'friend' is a wonderful word. Don't you agree?
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
...“朋友”是個很美好的詞。你不覺得嗎？

scripts.text: Allow me to introduce myself. I'm the Archer of all Archers, ^3131FFReidin Corse^000000, Master of the Icarus Guild!
scripts.translation: 請允許我自我介紹。我是所有弓箭手中的弓箭手，^3131FF雷丁·科斯^000000，伊卡洛斯公會的會長！

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Right now, we're having a special event! The application fee for the Icarus Guild has been slashed by 50%! Join now and there'll be no annual fees!
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
現在，我們正在舉辦特別活動！伊卡洛斯公會的入會費打五折！現在加入，免年費！

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
During our special event, we'll have no job class restrictions!
As an added bonus, all new male members will be introduced to beautiful Dancer girls!
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
在特別活動期間，我們沒有職業限制！
額外福利：所有新加入的男性成員都將有機會認識美麗的舞娘！

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
And new female members will have the special opportunity to go out on a date with me! Don't miss out!
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
而新加入的女性成員將有機會和我約會！千萬不要錯過！

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Join right now
for a one time fee of only ^3131FF1,000,000, zeny^000000! Hurry and join the Icarus Guild while
this offer still lasts!
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
現在加入，只需一次性支付^3131FF1,000,000 Zeny^000000！
趁優惠還在，趕緊加入伊卡洛斯公會吧！

scripts.text:
[Arpesto]
Reidin...
Stop messing around.
Hey there, kid. The real
master of the Icarus Guild
is in that building.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾佩斯托]
雷丁...
別鬧了。
嘿，小孩。伊卡洛斯公會真正的會長在那棟樓裡。

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Arpesto...!
Why'd you...?!
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
阿爾佩斯托...！
你...你怎麼...？！

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
^333333*Sigh*^000000
You got me, you got me.
There's no application fee.
But I'll still date all of
those cute girls...
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
^333333*嘆氣*^000000
好吧，好吧。
沒有入會費。
但我還是會和那些可愛的女孩們約會的...

scripts.text:
[Seisner]
Aaaah!
Double Strafe!
scripts.translation:
[賽斯納]
啊啊啊！
二連矢！

scripts.text:
[Seisner]
I did it!
Only an Archer
could make that shot!
scripts.translation:
[賽斯納]
我做到了！
只有弓箭手才能射出那一箭！

scripts.text:
[Seisner]
Now, there are some
Thief class people who also use arrows, but they're better suited to using Knives. We Archers are
the arrow specialists!
scripts.translation:
[賽斯納]
現在，雖然有些盜賊職業的人也會使用箭矢，但他們更適合使用匕首。我們弓箭手才是箭矢專家！

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou show Seisner
the letter that Master
Kavaruk has written
to her for you.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你向賽斯納展示卡瓦魯克大師為你寫的那封信。^000000

scripts.text:
[Seisner]
So Master Kavaruk
wants me to teach you
about Archers and Archery? Alright, what would you like to know more about?
scripts.translation:
[賽斯納]
原來卡瓦魯克大師想讓我教你關於弓箭手和射箭的知識？好的，你想了解哪方面？

scripts.text: About Archers.
scripts.translation: 關於弓箭手

scripts.text: Stats for Archers
scripts.translation: 弓箭手的屬性

scripts.text: End Conversation.
scripts.translation: 結束對話

scripts.text:
[Seisner]
Archers specialize
in shooting ^3131FFarrows^000000. We usually attack from a distance, but before we increase our Dodge Rate, we're pretty weak when it comes to one on one battles.
scripts.translation:
[賽斯納]
弓箭手擅長射擊^3131FF箭矢^000000。我們通常從遠處發起攻擊，但在殘影率之前，我們在單挑中比較脆弱。

scripts.text:
[Seisner]
Therefore, Archers tend to attack before the enemy gets too close.
We also like to party with other people who can offer close
range protection.
scripts.translation:
[賽斯納]
因此，弓箭手傾向於在敵人靠近之前發起攻擊。
我們也喜歡與其他能提供近身保護的人組隊。

scripts.text:
[Seisner]
Now, only Novices can
become Archers after reaching
Job Level 10 and learning all of the Basic Skills.
scripts.translation:
[賽斯納]
現在，只有初心者在達到職業等級10並學會所有基本技能後，才能轉職為弓箭手。

scripts.text:
[Seisner]
Well experienced Archers can move on and change to the Second Job Class, becoming ^3131FFHunters^000000, ^3131FFBards^000000 if they are male, or ^3131FFDancers^000000 if they are female.
scripts.translation:
[賽斯納]
經驗豐富的弓箭手可以進一步轉職為二轉職業，男性可以成為^3131FF獵人^000000或^3131FF詩人^000000，女性可以成為^3131FF舞娘^000000。

scripts.text:
[Seisner]
If you reach Level 99
as a Second Job Class character, you can change to a Transcendent Class with Valkyrie's help.
scripts.translation:
[賽斯納]
如果你作為二轉職業角色達到99級，可以在瓦爾基里的幫助下轉職為超轉職業。

scripts.text:
[Seisner]
Hunters can ultimately transcend into ^3131FFSnipers^000000, Bards into ^3131FFMinstrels^000000, and Dancers into ^3131FFGypsies^000000. I know that's pretty complex.
scripts.translation:
[賽斯納]
獵人最終可以轉職為^3131FF神射手^000000，詩人轉職為^3131FF宮廷樂師^000000，舞娘轉職為^3131FF冷豔舞姬^000000。我知道這有點複雜。

scripts.text:
[Seisner]
So you want to
know more about Stats
and how they affect Archer abilities? I'll do my best to explain.
scripts.translation:
[賽斯納]
所以你想了解更多關於屬性以及它們如何影響弓箭手能力？我會盡力解釋。

scripts.text: STR
scripts.translation: STR

scripts.text: VIT
scripts.translation: VIT

scripts.text: LUK
scripts.translation: LUK

scripts.text: End Conversation.
scripts.translation: 結束對話

scripts.text:
[Seisner]
STR typically increases the damage of attacks. However, Archer class characters use weapons that rely on ^FF3131DEX^000000 to increase their damage.
scripts.translation:
[賽斯納]
STR通常增加攻擊傷害。然而，弓箭手職業使用的武器依賴^FF3131DEX^000000來提升傷害。

scripts.text:
[Seisner]
In a sense, STR might not be necessary for Archers, although I'm sure there are skills or situations where STR will come in handy.
scripts.translation:
[賽斯納]
從某種意義上說，弓箭手可能不需要STR，但我相信有些技能或情況下STR會很有用。

scripts.text:
[Seisner]
For instance, if you run out of arrows (which is every Archer's nightmare) and need to equip a Knife, having some STR might
be helpful.
scripts.translation:
[賽斯納]
例如，如果你箭矢用完了（這是每個弓箭手的噩夢）並且需要裝備匕首，擁有一些STR可能會有幫助。

scripts.text:
[Seisner]
Increasing STR will also
increase the amount of weight
that any character can carry. So if you have more STR, you can carry around more arrows.
scripts.translation:
[賽斯納]
增加STR也會增加角色可以攜帶的重量。所以如果你有更多的STR，你可以攜帶更多的箭矢。

scripts.text:
[Seisner]
^FF3131AGI^000000 as you know, 
^3131Ffincreases Attack Speed
(ASPD)^000000 and affects ^3131FF Dodge Rate^000000.
scripts.translation:
[賽斯納]
^FF3131AGI^000000如你所知，^3131Ff提升攻擊速度(ASPD)^000000，並影響^3131FF閃避率^000000。

scripts.text:
[Seisner]
One of the drawbacks of being an Archer is having weaker strength and lower Dodge Rate. However, the Dodge Rate disadvantage is lessened by increasing your ^FF3131AGI^000000.
scripts.translation:
[賽斯納]
作為弓箭手的一個缺點是力量較弱且閃避率較低。不過，通過提升^FF3131AGI^000000可以減輕閃避率上的劣勢。

scripts.text:
[Seisner]
^3131FFVIT^000000 will increase
your Maximum HP and
resistance to damage.
scripts.translation:
[賽斯納]
^3131FFVIT^000000會提升你的最大HP以及對傷害的抗性。

scripts.text:
[Seisner]
Although Archers don't
specialize in having any special kind of defense, having VIT will help alleviate the defensive weakness of the Archer class.
scripts.translation:
[賽斯納]
雖然弓箭手並不以某種特殊的防禦見長，但提升VIT有助於彌補弓箭手職業在防禦上的弱點。

scripts.text:
[Seisner]
VIT might be helpful
depending on how you use it. Still, I wouldn't recommend focusing too much on increasing your VIT if you're an Archer.
scripts.translation:
[賽斯納]
VIT是否有幫助取決於你的用法。不過，如果你是弓箭手，我不太建議你過度專注於提升VIT。

scripts.text:
[Seisner]
^FF0000INT^000000 is more
important to the
Archer class than
you would think~
scripts.translation:
[賽斯納]
^FF0000INT^000000對弓箭手職業的重要性比你想像的要高~

scripts.text:
[Seisner]
As you increase ^FF0000INT^000000, you'll raise your Maximum SP, meaning you
can use special skills more often.
scripts.translation:
[賽斯納]
隨著^FF0000INT^000000的提升，你的最大SP也會增加，這意味著你可以更頻繁地使用特殊技能。

scripts.text:
[Seisner]
For Hunters, one of the Second Job Classes for Archers, having higher INT will increase the damage inflicted by ^3131FFFalcons^000000.
scripts.translation:
[賽斯納]
對於獵人（弓箭手的二轉職業之一）來說，較高的INT會增加^3131FF獵鷹^000000造成的傷害。

scripts.text:
[Seisner]
Now DEX is almost
without a doubt the
most important stat
for any Archer.
scripts.translation:
[賽斯納]
現在，DEX幾乎可以確定是任何弓箭手最重要的屬性。

scripts.text:
[Seisner]
^FF3131DEX^000000 ^3131Ffincreases the damage^000000
of Archer class weapons that fire arrows. These include ^3131FFBows^000000, ^3131FFInstruments^000000 and ^3131FFWhips^000000.

[Seisner]
Dexterity enhances an Archer's ability to hit weak points and do more damage, which is why weapons that use arrows don't rely on STR like weapons used by other classes.
scripts.translation:
[賽斯納]
靈巧提升了弓箭手擊中弱點並造成更多傷害的能力，這就是為什麼使用箭矢的武器不像其他職業的武器那樣依賴STR。

scripts.text:
[Seisner]
Just like any other class, ^FF3131DEX^000000 increases ^3131FFAccuracy (HIT)^000000 and slightly enhances Attack Speed (ASPD).
scripts.translation:
[賽斯納]
就像其他職業一樣，^FF3131DEX^000000提升^3131FF命中率(HIT)^000000，並略微提升攻擊速度(ASPD)。

scripts.text:
[Seisner]
^FF0000LUK^000000 affects your
Perfect Dodge rate
and Critical rate.
scripts.translation:
[賽斯納]
^FF0000LUK^000000影響你的完美閃避率和暴擊率。

scripts.text:
[Seisner]
For Hunters, one of the Second Classes for the Archer, LUK increases the chance of ^3131FFBlitz Beat^000000 occurring automatically. So Hunters who rely on their Falcons might want to invest in LUK.
scripts.translation:
[賽斯納]
對於弓箭手的二轉職業獵人來說，LUK會增加^3131FF閃電衝擊^000000自動觸發的機率。所以依賴獵鷹的獵人可能會想投資LUK。

scripts.text:
[Seisner]
So is there
anything else that
you want to ask me?
scripts.translation:
[賽斯納]
那麼，還有什麼你想問我的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Seisner]
Once an Archer shoots an arrow,
he can't stop its flight or change his target. That's why Archers need to be level headed and really careful in battle.
scripts.translation:
[賽斯納]
一旦弓箭手射出箭矢，他就無法停止其飛行或改變目標。因此，弓箭手在戰鬥中需要保持冷靜並格外小心。

scripts.text:
[Seisner]
Someday, I'd like to become a great Archer and use my skills for the good of Rune-Midgarts.
scripts.translation:
[賽斯納]
總有一天，我想成為一名偉大的弓箭手，並運用我的技能為盧恩·米德加茲的福祉服務。

scripts.text:
[Seisner]
Thanks for listening.
I know I gave you a lot of information, but I think it's important that everyone
understands archery.
scripts.translation:
[賽斯納]
謝謝你的傾聽。
我知道我給了你很多資訊，但我認為每個人都應該瞭解射箭。

scripts.text:
[Seisner]
If you feel comfortable enough with the knowledge I've taught you, you should go back to Master Kavaruk. But if you still have questions, you can always come and ask me.
scripts.translation:
[賽斯納]
如果你覺得已經掌握了我教你的知識，你應該回到卡瓦魯克大師那裡。但如果你還有疑問，隨時可以來問我。

scripts.text:
[Acolyte]
H-hello!
Umm, umm...
Are you R-Reidin Corse's
friend t-too?
scripts.translation:
[服事]
嗨...你好！
嗯，那個...
你也是雷丁·科斯的朋友嗎？

scripts.text:
[Acolyte]
^666666Zzzzz...^000000
Wh-wha...?
Who are you?

[Acolyte]
Okay~!
Let me try
casting a spell
to help you! Yaa~p!
scripts.translation:
[服事]
好~！
讓我試著施展一個法術來幫幫你吧！耶~！

scripts.text:
[Acolyte]
...
W-why does
traveling make
me sooo sleepy...?
^666666Zzzzzzzz...^000000

[Acolyte]
M-my name is Mafra.
Ever since he saved my life, Reidin has a-always been a good f-friend to me. He's such a great Archer
and a really nice person!
scripts.translation:
[服事]
我...我叫瑪芙拉。
自從他救了我的命，雷丁就一直是我...我最好的朋友。他是個很棒的弓箭手，而且人真的很好！

scripts.text:
[Acolyte]
Um, and...
Uh... Oh no~
What am I supposed
t-to tell you...?
scripts.translation:
[服事]
那個，還有...
呃...糟糕~
我該跟你說點什...什麼好呢...？

scripts.text:
[Acolyte]
Oh, since I'm training to be an Acolyte, I'm supposed to help out the people he's teaching. So...
Let's h-help each other train!
Um, is that okay?
scripts.translation:
[服事]
哦，既然我正在接受服事的訓練，我應該要幫助他教導的人。所以...
讓我們互相幫...幫忙訓練吧！
嗯，這樣可以嗎？

scripts.text: Sure.
scripts.translation: 當然

scripts.text: No thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，謝謝

scripts.text: Reidin Corse is mine!
scripts.translation: 雷丁·科斯是我的！

scripts.text:
[Acolyte]
Wow!
Thank you, thank you!
I''ll try my very best!
scripts.translation:
[服事]
哇！
謝謝你，謝謝你！
我會盡我最大的努力的！

scripts.text:
[Acolyte]
Oh... Oh.
I'm so sorry.
If you don't need
my help, I guess
that's alright...
scripts.translation:
[服事]
啊...啊。
真對不起。
如果你不需要我的幫助，那...那也沒關係...

scripts.text:
[Acolyte]
Eh?!
R-really?
I guess he doesn't
need to tell me if
he already has a girlfriend...
scripts.translation:
[服事]
誒？！
真...真的嗎？
他已經有女朋友了，也沒必要告訴我吧...

scripts.text:
[Acolyte]
And he's so brave
and funny and smart.
Y-you're lucky to have him.
^333333*Sniff*^000000 I... I...
scripts.translation:
[服事]
而且他很勇敢，又有趣又聰明。
你...你真幸運能擁有他。
^333333*吸鼻子*^000000 我...我...

scripts.text:
[Acolyte]
W-wait!
Y-you're a man!
D-d-d-don't tease me
like that! I'm serious!
scripts.translation:
[服事]
等...等一下！
你...你是個男人！
別...別那樣捉弄我！我是認真的！

scripts.text:
[Acolyte]
^333333*Sniffle*^000000
I'll d-do my best to help you!
I wish you both happiness! (Waaaaaah~!)
scripts.translation:
[服事]
^333333*抽泣*^000000
我會盡我所能幫助你的！
祝你們幸福！（哇啊啊啊~！）

scripts.text:
[Acolyte]
Wait, I know...
Y-you're... ^666666*Yawn*^000000
So sleepy. Take this for now...

[Acolyte]
Reidin Corse?
I can't believe
I feel asleep fo--
^666666Zzzzzzz...^000000
scripts.translation:
[服事]
雷丁·科斯？
我不敢相信我竟然睡——
^666666呼嚕嚕嚕...^000000

scripts.text:
[Acolyte]
^666666Zzzz^000000--Oooh!
J-just take this before
I fall asleep again~! ^666666*Yawn*^000000

...
W-why does
traveling make
me sooo sleepy...?
^666666Zzzzzzzz...^000000

[Alchemist Guildmember]
Great...!
I've been waiting
for the Icarus Guild
to send somebody
to help us! Finally!
scripts.translation:
[鍊金術士公會成員]
太好了...！
我一直在等伊卡洛斯公會派人來幫我們！終於來了！

scripts.text:
[Alchemist Guildmember]
I don't know if you've heard
from Kavaruk, but our Flora field is getting ruined by stray cats.
scripts.translation:
[鍊金術士公會成員]
我不知道你有沒有從卡瓦魯克那裡聽到，但我們的芙羅拉田地被流浪貓破壞了。

scripts.text:
[Alchemist Guildmember]
^666666*Sigh...*^000000
Isn't anyone coming
to help us? We're facing
a really huge crisis here!
scripts.translation:
[鍊金術士公會成員]
^666666*嘆氣...*^000000
沒有人來幫我們嗎？我們正面臨一場巨大的危機！

scripts.text:
[Alchemist Guildmember]
Would you like to sell ^3131FFStems^000000
and ^3131FFManeater Blossoms^000000 to
the Alchemist Guild? We'll buy
each Stem for ^3131FF30 Zeny^000000 and each
Maneater Blossom for ^3131FF130 Zeny^000000.
scripts.translation:
[鍊金術士公會成員]
您是否願意將^3131FF莖^000000和^3131FF噬人樹花^000000賣給鍊金術士公會？
我們會以每根莖^3131FF30 Zeny^000000、每朵噬人樹花^3131FF130 Zeny^000000的價格收購。

scripts.text: Sell all Stems and Maneater Blossoms
scripts.translation: 出售所有莖和噬人樹花

scripts.text: Don't sell anything.
scripts.translation: 什麼都不賣

scripts.text:
[Alchemist Guildmember]
Thank you very much!
This will really help
us in maintaining our
Flora field! I really
appreciate your help~
scripts.translation:
[鍊金術士公會成員]
非常感謝！
這對我們維護芙羅拉田幫助很大！
真的很感激您的幫助~

scripts.text:
[Alchemist Guildmember]
Seriously...
I'm on the verge of begging!
The Alchemist Guild really needs lots of new supplies to keep our Flora field running!
scripts.translation:
[鍊金術士公會成員]
說真的...
我簡直要開口求你了！
鍊金術士公會急需大量新物資來維持芙羅拉田的運作！

scripts.text:
[Alchemist Guildmember]
No matter how much we chase
them away, they always manage to come back. We really have no choice but to replace what they destroy.
scripts.translation:
[鍊金術士公會成員]
無論我們怎麼驅趕它們，它們總是設法回來。
我們別無選擇，只能替換被它們破壞的部分。

scripts.text:
[Alchemist Guildmember]
We'll reward you if you can bring us ^3131FFStems^000000 and ^3131FFManeater Blossoms^000000
to help us in our field maintenance efforts. These Flora are crucial since they provide funds for our guild. Without them...
scripts.translation:
[鍊金術士公會成員]
如果您能帶來^3131FF莖^000000和^3131FF噬人樹花^000000幫助我們維護田地，我們會給您獎勵。
這些芙羅拉至關重要，因為它們為公會提供資金。如果沒有它們...

scripts.text:
^666666*Sigh...*^000000
Isn't anyone coming
to help us? We're facing
a really huge crisis here!
scripts.translation:
^666666*嘆氣...*^000000
沒有人來幫我們嗎？
我們正面臨一場巨大的危機！

scripts.text:
[Arthail]
I am the Bard
who sings only for
himself. The gentle
breeze is the only
audience I have.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾塞爾]
我是隻為自己歌唱的詩人。
微風是我唯一的聽眾。

scripts.text:
[Arthail]
I see...
Nothing much.
Another person
found an Emperium
and is starting a
brand new guild...
scripts.translation:
[阿爾塞爾]
原來如此...
沒什麼大事。
又有人找到了華麗金屬，正在組建一個全新的公會...

scripts.text:
[Arthail]
Where did you go?
I thought you might have been kidnapped since you weren't
here when I woke up.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾塞爾]
你去哪了？
我醒來時你不在這裡，還以為你被綁架了呢。

scripts.text:
[Arthail]
I'm ashamed to ask,
but would you go the fountain in Prontera's central plaza and see
if there's any news?
scripts.translation:
[阿爾塞爾]
我很不好意思開口，但你能去普隆德拉中央廣場的噴泉那裡，看看有沒有什麼訊息嗎？

scripts.text:
[Arthail]
I am Arthail
of the Wind.
I sing for no man,
so you had best be on
your way. I'm sorry, but
I have no songs to share.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾塞爾]
我是風之阿爾塞爾。
我不為任何人歌唱，所以你最好還是走吧。
抱歉，我沒有歌可以分享。

scripts.text: Master Kavaruk told me to find you!
scripts.translation: 卡瓦魯克大師讓我來找你！

scripts.text:
[Arthail]
Really now?
I suppose it
can't be helped.
I really should
have contacted him.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾塞爾]
真的嗎？
看來沒辦法了。
我本該聯絡他的。

scripts.text:
[Arthail]
However, I'm very tired from the long trip. I'm exhausted from the crowding of this city and the hundreds of talking people.
I can't handle it all...
scripts.translation:
[阿爾塞爾]
不過，長途跋涉讓我非常疲憊。這座城市的擁擠和數百個說話的人讓我精疲力竭。
我應付不了這一切...

scripts.text:
[Arthail]
Why can't I be like everyone else? It seems that as I approach people, my heart retreats further away from them. I wonder why that is?
scripts.translation:
[阿爾塞爾]
為什麼我不能像其他人一樣？
似乎每當我接近別人，我的心就離他們更遠。我不知道這是為什麼？

scripts.text:
[Arthail]
I became a Bard to try to fix this social complex of mine, but to
no avail. Still, I feel much more at ease when I sing. Ah, but I've said too much already.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾塞爾]
我成為詩人是為了試圖克服這種社交障礙，但無濟於事。不過，當我唱歌時，我感覺輕鬆多了。啊，我好像說得太多了。

scripts.text:
[Arthail]
Master Kavaruk
asked you to help
me? Well then, I have
a favor to ask of you.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾塞爾]
卡瓦魯克大師讓你來幫我？
既然這樣，我有件事想拜託你。

scripts.text:
[Arthail]
Here in the capital of the
Rune-Midgarts Kingdom, there's supposed to be a fountain in the central plaza. Everyone seems to stop and chat over there.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾塞爾]
在盧恩·米德加茲王國的首都，中央廣場上據說有一座噴泉。
大家都喜歡在那裡停下來聊天。

scripts.text:
[Arthail]
However, I have a fear of other people and I can't bring myself to go near the crowds of people there. It's embarassing for me to admit this as a Bard...
scripts.translation:
[阿爾塞爾]
但是，我害怕與人接觸，根本不敢靠近那裡的人群。
作為一名詩人，承認這一點讓我很尷尬...

scripts.text:
[Arthail]
Would you please go and see if there's any news being spread around in that area for me?
scripts.translation:
[阿爾塞爾]
能麻煩你去那裡看看，有沒有什麼訊息在流傳嗎？

scripts.text:
[Arthail]
^3131FFEmperium^000000...
There are a lot of ambitious people in Morocc that want one of those. Even in my hometown of Payon,
there are people clamoring to obtain one...
scripts.translation:
[阿爾塞爾]
^3131FF華麗金屬^000000...
夢羅克有很多野心勃勃的人想要得到它。甚至在我的家鄉斐揚，也有很多人渴望獲得它...

scripts.text:
[Arthail]
Supposedly, having an Emperium
will give you the power to change the world. People are bound to be attracted to it.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾塞爾]
據說，擁有華麗金屬就能獲得改變世界的力量。
人們自然會被它吸引。

scripts.text:
[Arthail]
Hmm...?
I sense something
dark and ominous...
I wonder what it could be?
scripts.translation:
[阿爾塞爾]
嗯...？
我感覺到某種黑暗而陰森的氣息...
不知道那會是什麼？

scripts.text:
[Arthail]
I'm probably just stressed and exhausted. I'll feel better once
I get some rest. Would you like to join me and listen to the flowing water?
scripts.translation:
[阿爾塞爾]
我大概只是太緊張和疲憊了。
休息一下就會好多了。你想和我一起聽聽流水聲嗎？

scripts.text:
[Arthail]
It's not the greatest feeling if you stay here for too long, but the sound of this water reminds me of home. Did you see the lake by the Icarus Guild? These waters remind me of that place.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾塞爾]
在這裡待太久感覺並不好，但這流水聲讓我想起了家鄉。
你看到伊卡洛斯公會旁邊的湖了嗎？這水讓我想起了那個地方。

scripts.text:
[Arthail]
^333333*Yawn...*^000000
I haven't talked
like this in so long.
I'm so tired, I think
I'll rest just a little...
scripts.translation:
[阿爾塞爾]
^333333*打哈欠...*^000000
我已經很久沒有這樣聊天了。
我太累了，想稍微休息一下...

scripts.text:
^3355FFArthail of the Wind
has fallen fast asleep.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF風之阿爾塞爾已經沉沉睡去。^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Ah...
So peaceful~
^3355FFThe rhythm of the lapping waters gently eases you into a state of perfect relaxation. The cold, crisp water would feel so refreshing if you dipped your feet into it...^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF潺潺的流水聲輕柔地讓你進入一種完全放鬆的狀態。如果將雙腳浸入冰冷清澈的水中，一定會感到無比清爽...^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Huh?
What was
that noise?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
咦？
剛才那是什麼聲音？

scripts.text:
[????]
AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAHHHHHHHHHHH!!!!!

[{0}]
What the--?!
That sounds like
screams coming from
inside Prontera Castle!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
什麼--？！
那聽起來像是從普隆德拉王宮裡面傳出的尖叫聲！

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou try to wake Arthail
but he's deeply asleep
and won't budge at all.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你試圖叫醒阿爾塞爾，但他睡得很沉，怎麼叫都叫不醒。^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I can't help it then.
I'd better go check
this out on my own.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
沒辦法了。
我還是自己去檢視一下吧。

scripts.text:
[Arthail]
So everyone said nothing
happened when you asked
about the shrieks you heard?
That's really peculiar...
scripts.translation:
[阿爾塞爾]
所以大家都說，當你詢問那些尖叫聲時，什麼也沒發生？
這真的很奇怪...

scripts.text:
[Arthail]
Even the Emperium you mentioned earlier. I thought it was supposed to be a rare item, but why is it so easy for so many people to get
one? It's very strange...
scripts.translation:
[阿爾塞爾]
還有你之前提到的華麗金屬。我以為那是稀有物品，但為什麼這麼多人能輕易獲得？這非常蹊蹺...

scripts.text:
[Arthail]
Huh. I better investigate this
a little more, so I'll stay here to gather more information. For now, you should head back to Payon and let Master Kavaruk know that I'm doing alright.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾塞爾]
嗯。我最好再調查一下，所以我會留在這裡收集更多資訊。現在，你應該回斐揚，告訴卡瓦魯克大師我沒事。

scripts.text:
[Arthail]
And one day...
I guess I'll finally
have a song that
I can share with you.
scripts.translation:
[阿爾塞爾]
總有一天...
我想我終於能有一首可以與你分享的歌了。

scripts.text:
[New Guild Master]
Hearken, all
of you who seek
fame and glory!
scripts.translation:
[新任公會會長]
聽好了，所有追求名聲與榮耀的人！

scripts.text:
[New Guild Master]
I hold in my hand this ^3131FFEmperium^000000, sign that I am favored by destiny! Brave ones, I bid you, lend me
your power!
scripts.translation:
[新任公會會長]
我手中握著這塊^3131FF華麗金屬^000000，這是命運眷顧我的證明！勇敢的戰士們，我命令你們，將力量借給我！

scripts.text:
[New Guild Master]
Nothing can stop us!
So long as this jewel
is in my possession,
those who call themselves
my comrades will never
know the taste of defeat!
scripts.translation:
[新任公會會長]
沒有什麼能阻擋我們！
只要這塊寶石在我手中，那些自稱我同志的人將永遠不會嚐到失敗的滋味！

scripts.text:
[Mage]
Did you see that
new guild master?
Talk about getting
on your soapbox!
scripts.translation:
[魔法師]
你看到那個新任公會會長了嗎？
真是愛說大話啊！

scripts.text:
[Mage]
Doesn't he know that there
are a lot of famous guilds around nowadays? Why would anyone want
to join his small no-name guild?
scripts.translation:
[魔法師]
他難道不知道現在有很多著名的公會嗎？為什麼會有人想加入他那個不知名的小公會？

scripts.text:
[Mage]
Now, if I become a Wizard,
I'm going to join the best guild around. Casting spells to help the strongest Knights and the most powerful Priests would make me
look really cool!
scripts.translation:
[魔法師]
現在，如果我成為巫師，我要加入最好的公會。施法幫助最強的騎士和最強大的牧師，那看起來一定很酷！

scripts.text:
[Mage]
Bwahahah!
Just thinking
about it makes
me so excited!
scripts.translation:
[魔法師]
哇哈哈！
光是想想就讓我興奮不已！

scripts.text:
[Minister]
The royal family
is extremely busy
at the moment, handling
our nation's administration.
scripts.translation:
[大臣]
王室目前非常忙碌，正在處理國家的政務。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I heard screams
from outside! Did
something happen?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我聽到外面有尖叫聲！
發生什麼事了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Minister]
...
......

[Minister]
Ah, there are a few stray cats running around, those Wild Roses, so those noises you heard must have been them. Everything is fine here in the palace.
scripts.translation:
[大臣]
啊，有幾隻流浪貓在附近亂跑，那些狂暴野貓，所以你聽到的聲音一定是它們發出的。王宮裡一切正常。

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe urgency that the Minister expressed earlier has been
replaced with a stone cold feeling of sternness. He probably won't tell you much more information,
no matter how much you ask him.
scripts.translation:
^3355FF大臣先前表現出的緊迫感，此刻已化作一種冰冷的嚴厲。
無論你怎麼追問，他恐怕都不會透露更多訊息了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Um...
I hear that
the royal family
might be in sort of
trouble. Is there any
way I could help?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那個...
我聽說王室可能遇到了一些麻煩。有沒有什麼辦法我能幫上忙？

scripts.text:
[Minister]
...
......

[Minister]
You must be mistaken.
The royal family is fine,
especially since our
kingdom is at peace.
scripts.translation:
[大臣]
你一定是搞錯了。
王室很好，尤其是我們的王國正處於和平時期。

scripts.text:
[Minister]
Perhaps you've gotten that idea because it's very difficult to meet any member of the royal family. Please understand that they're
all very busy trying to serve
the people.
scripts.translation:
[大臣]
也許你會有這種想法，是因為很難見到王室的任何成員。請理解，他們都非常忙碌，正在努力服務人民。

scripts.text:
[Minister]
As a holy servant, I'm sure that you'll find plenty of other people who have need of your help and abilities outside of the palace.
scripts.translation:
[大臣]
作為神聖的侍者，我相信你會在王宮之外找到許多需要你的幫助和能力的人。

scripts.text:
[Minister]
Contact the
Prontera Church.
Hurry, this is urgent!
scripts.translation:
[大臣]
聯絡普隆德拉教會。
快，情況緊急！

scripts.text:
[Bishop Maugins]
Greetings.
I doubt that you're here to change to the Monk job, but may I help you with something? Perhaps you're
here for a confession?
scripts.translation:
[主教 莫金斯]
你好。
我想你並不是來轉職為武僧的，有什麼我可以幫你的嗎？
或許你是來做告解的？

scripts.text:
[Bishop Maugins]
I'm sorry, but I have
some pressing matter
to think about right now.
Would you come back later?
scripts.translation:
[主教 莫金斯]
抱歉，我現在正有一些緊急事務需要思考。
請稍後再來好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Bishop Maugins]
Hm? Work related to
the Palace? Yes, I'm in
charge of that area. So
how may I help you?
scripts.translation:
[主教 莫金斯]
嗯？與王宮有關的工作？
是的，我負責那個區域。
那麼，有什麼我可以幫你的嗎？

scripts.text: Has something happened to the Kingdom?
scripts.translation: 王國發生什麼事了嗎？

scripts.text: Nothing.
scripts.translation: 沒什麼

scripts.text:
[Bishop Maugins]
...!!
scripts.translation:
[主教 莫金斯]
...!!

scripts.text:
[Bishop Maugins]
...
......

[Bishop Maugins]
Ho ho~
Of course not!
The king and I regularly write to each other, but I haven't heard of anything in particular. Please don't worry yourself.
scripts.translation:
[主教 莫金斯]
呵呵~
當然沒有！
我和國王經常通訊，但我沒有聽說有什麼特別的事情。請不要擔心。

scripts.text:
[Bishop Maugins]
Good luck on
your journeys,
brave adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[主教 莫金斯]
祝你在旅途中好運，勇敢的冒險者。
